name: Shopify Inc.
description: Shopify Inc. provides a cloud-based multi-channel commerce platform for small and medium-sized businesses. The company's platform enables merchants to run their business across all sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. Shopify Payments processes over 58% of platform GMV, and Shopify Capital provides merchant financing.

latest_analysis.executive_summary: Shopify presents a compelling medium-term buy. Cash flow has turned decisively positive and margins are expanding. The main risk is valuation — any deceleration in growth could compress the multiple. The risk/reward still favors initiating or adding a position with conservative sizing.
key_drivers: FCF margin expanded to 14.2% in FY2025 (durable cash generation)
Gross Merchandise Volume grew 23% YoY to $281B
Operating leverage is materializing as headcount growth slows
Balance sheet is strong with low meaningful debt

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: This medium-term growth thesis matches a registered-account allocation focused on capital appreciation.
layer2_context.suggested_action: Hold and consider adding on pullbacks toward support; keep sizing conservative given valuation risk.
